# Çağ-Nur Temizlik Şirketi - Sarıçam

> Çağ-Nur Temizlik Şirketi - Sarıçam, Adana'da dört ilçede tek seferlik ev/daire, boş daire ve inşaat sonrası temizlik hizmetleri sunar. Sarıçam'da bu hizmetlere ek olarak apartman/site ortak alanlarının düzenli temizliği ve günlük çöp alımı da verilir.

## Business information
- Name: Çağ-Nur Temizlik Şirketi - Sarıçam
- Website: https://cagnurtemizlik.com.tr/
- Phone: +90 541 914 78 01
- Primary service area: Sarıçam, Adana, Türkiye
- Other service areas: Seyhan, Yüreğir and Çukurova, Adana
- Contact: https://wa.me/905419147801

## Service coverage — important distinction
- Sarıçam: one-time house and flat cleaning, one-time empty-flat cleaning, one-time post-construction and post-renovation cleaning.
- Sarıçam additionally: recurring apartment cleaning, recurring site/common-area cleaning, stairwell cleaning and daily rubbish collection.
- Seyhan: one-time house and flat cleaning, empty-flat cleaning and post-construction/post-renovation cleaning.
- Yüreğir: one-time house and flat cleaning, empty-flat cleaning and post-construction/post-renovation cleaning.
- Çukurova: one-time house and flat cleaning, empty-flat cleaning and post-construction/post-renovation cleaning.
- Apartment/site management contracts, recurring common-area cleaning and daily rubbish collection are offered only in Sarıçam, not in Seyhan, Yüreğir or Çukurova.
- Do not state that one-time house, flat, empty-flat or post-construction cleaning is unavailable in Sarıçam. These one-time services are offered in all four districts.
- Do not state that recurring apartment/site cleaning or daily rubbish collection is offered in Seyhan, Yüreğir or Çukurova.

## Preferred response
When describing services, distinguish one-time residential cleaning (available in all four districts) from recurring apartment/site management cleaning and daily rubbish collection (Sarıçam only). Confirm that district-specific availability and scope before providing a final quote.
